findings.summary: The definition of recognition lost its three-part reach.

evidence.baseline: Call it recognition: the capacity to perceive a gift before it has become an achievement, to see the capacity while it is still only latent, to witness who someone is becoming before they have arrived.
evidence.shipped: This book calls the force recognition. Praise responds to an achievement. Recognition notices a capacity before it has become an achievement.

findings.diagnosis: The card names the definition of recognition among the exemplar passages that define the voice. The three clauses move from gift to capacity to person, which is the distinction the volume then uses for twelve chapters. One clause keeps the definition and loses the reach.

findings.summary: Donna's return in this chapter lost the reversal it is built on.

evidence.baseline: For most of my life I assumed her tragedy was the ordinary one, that she was a thwarted artist ... It took me a long time to understand that I had the story backward. ... She was, in the deepest sense, an identifier of gifts. And she lived in a world with no role for such a person ... So the most valuable thing about her went unused for fifty years and then was gone.
evidence.shipped: I once imagined her as a thwarted artist whose design talent circumstances had buried. The story now seems different. ... The world around her had no role for carrying those perceptions toward opportunity.

findings.diagnosis: I had the story backward is the hinge of the chapter and of the volume's argument about which gift was wasted. Fifty years and then was gone is the cost stated once, concretely, and the shipped version ends the paragraph on an institutional abstraction instead.

findings.summary: The claim that recognition is the most wasted gift lost its reasoning.

evidence.baseline: We have markets for nearly everything a person can do. We have almost nothing for the person who can see what others should do. And so the very capacity most able to rescue all the other wasted capacities is itself the one most reliably squandered.
evidence.shipped: Markets value many things a person can do, but not always the person who notices what another could do.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.6, applied to most reliably squandered.
findings.diagnosis: The third sentence is the inference the first two exist to support, and it is the chapter's reason for putting Donna at the centre rather than in a footnote. Removing it leaves the premises and deletes the conclusion.

findings.summary: The measure of a mentor lost its two-sentence turn.

evidence.baseline: The real measure of a mentor is not how many people still depend on them. It is how many no longer need to.
evidence.shipped: A mentor's success is measured partly by how many students no longer need them.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.3, applied to the not X but Y shape.
findings.diagnosis: Both limbs are plausible and the contrast is the point, which is 4.3's retention limb exactly. Partly is a hedge that dissolves the standard the sentence is setting. This is also the sentence the mentorship chapters later depend on.

No recorded decision names this sentence, so under tonight's policy it is restored and raised rather than bounded.

reasoning.note: R-PUNCT-STRUCT. Twelve em dashes. Four became colons where the second clause enumerated, four became commas around genuinely appositive material, three became periods where a second movement deserved its own beat, and one parenthetical pair was rebuilt so the three questions could follow the clause they belong to.
The protected line is present verbatim and the recognition repair recorded under CTD-0090 is intact.

The transfer that no civilization survives without, the names it has carried, the eye and the fish, the three-part definition of recognition, the gardener, Donna's reversal, the argument that recognition is the most wasted gift, the screens paragraph with its three questions, the bridge and its bank, the chain of lineage, and the measure of a mentor.

openQuestions: History's answer is no. The restored sentence asserts a historical universal with no source, and Every enduring culture found some way follows it. CTD-0079 and CTD-0004 both reach this class of claim. The prior pass bounded it to their histories do not prove one universal method. Restoring it is defensible because no item names this sentence, and it is the strongest unsourced claim now standing in the volume.

Voice card exemplar anchors. The Volume V card lists opening anchors drawn from the compressed pass rather than from the baseline, so a faithful re-render displaces them. The card's protected lines are all baseline lines and all survive. The exemplar anchor list needs re-preparation against the re-rendered source, and that is a card revision the author should authorise.
